arithmetic.precision_scope: No certified rounding-error bound; conditioning, feature approximation, and callback cancellation may prevent the requested target

budget.semantics: Soft wall-clock budget between numerical calls, with one trial of an already-computed direction; hard residual evaluation-count limit

solver.convergence_scope: Declared sampled/aggregated residual blocks only; no continuum error, uniqueness, identifiability, or omitted-condition certificate
solver.method: Damped Gauss-Newton, matrix-free LSMR, local pointwise Torch derivatives, diagonal/bounded-block right preconditioning with optional automatic selection, projected parameter bounds
solver.callback_contract: Callbacks must be pointwise across rows; explicit aggregation supplies weak/integral coupling; optional le/ge hinge follows aggregation
solver.storage_note: No Q-by-coefficient feature cache; O(Q) local sensitivities and residual/Krylov vectors retained; bounded point/column panels; optional prepared neuron readouts/adjoints use O(neurons * fields) storage, counted in product_counts; supplied dense aggregation is counted separately. Byte metrics are array accounting, not process peak RSS.

features.coordinate_scope: Analytical disk angular coordinates; orthonormal for ideal U_n profiles, actual tanh encoding retains approximation error; no fitted conversion map

ordinary_audit.coordinate_diagnostic_note: Same learned coordinates evaluated by actual MLP versus ideal analytical coordinate basis; not truth error.
ordinary_audit.symmetry_note: Descriptive only: the finite-Re driven flow need not be reflection-symmetric.
ordinary_audit.ordinary_export: Linear/Tanh/Linear, float64, ordinary Torch automatic differentiation

reynolds.convention: diameter/side length 2 and peak prescribed boundary speed

limitations: No exact interior solution: residual and refinement agreement are evidence, not a proof.
Steady moderate-Re flow; no claim about turbulence or uniqueness at arbitrary Reynolds number.
Smooth circular boundary and analytic tangential trace avoid polygon corners.
